grammarRule.formula: Subject + must / have to + Base Verb (V1) | You mustn't...

explanation.ml: കർശനമായ നിയമങ്ങൾ, ഉത്തരവുകൾ, അത്യന്താപേക്ഷിതമായ ബാധ്യതകൾ എന്നിവ പറയാൻ 'must' (തീർച്ചയായും ചെയ്യണം) എന്നും, ബാഹ്യമായ നിയമങ്ങൾ പാലിക്കാൻ 'have to' (ചെയ്യേണ്ടതുണ്ട്) എന്നും ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Compulsion & Rules: Must vs Have to with clear formula: Subject + must / have to + Base Verb (V1) | You mustn't...

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 കർശന വിലക്കുകൾക്ക് 'mustn't' ഉപയോഗിക്കുക: 'You mustn't park here' (ഇവിടെ പാർക്ക് ചെയ്യാൻ പാടില്ല - നിയമവിരുദ്ധമാണ്). ആവശ്യകത ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കാൻ 'don't have to' ഉപയോഗിക്കുക: 'You don't have to wear a suit' (ധരിക്കേണ്ടതില്ല - നിർബന്ധമില്ല).
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 കർശന വിലക്കുകൾക്ക് 'mustn't' ഉപയോഗിക്കുക: 'You mustn't park here' (ഇവിടെ പാർക്ക് ചെയ്യാൻ പാടില്ല - നിയമവിരുദ്ധമാണ്). ആവശ്യകത ഇല്ലാതിരിക്കാൻ 'don't have to' ഉപയോഗിക്കുക: 'You don't have to wear a suit' (ധരിക്കേണ്ടതില്ല - നിർബന്ധമില്ല).

nouns.definition: An act or course of action to which a person is morally or legally bound; a duty.
nouns.example: Citizens have a legal obligation to follow highway speed regulations.

nouns.definition: Required by law or rules; compulsory.
nouns.example: Wearing a protective helmet is mandatory for all motorcycle riders.

nouns.definition: A rule or directive made and maintained by an authority.
nouns.example: All chemical lab visitors must comply with safety regulations.

nouns.definition: Demanding that rules concerning behavior or process are obeyed and observed.
nouns.example: The university maintains strict anti-plagiarism guidelines for research papers.

nouns.definition: A punishment imposed for breaking a law, rule, or contract.
nouns.example: Violating traffic red signals incurs a heavy statutory monetary penalty.

nouns.definition: A thing that is needed or wanted; a condition that must be met.
nouns.example: A valid passport is an essential requirement for international departures.

traps.question: Select the sentence expressing strict legal prohibition:
options: You don't have to smoke here.
You shouldn't smoke here if you want.
traps.explanation: 'You mustn't smoke here' means it is forbidden by law/rule. 'You don't have to' merely means it is optional.

traps.question: Choose the correct sentence to express an absence of obligation (it is optional):
options: You mustn't wear a tie to the casual dinner.
You don't have to wear a tie to the casual dinner.
You haven't to wear a tie.
You must not have wearing a tie.
traps.explanation: 'You don't have to' expresses that something is not required / optional.
traps.ruleHint: Lack of Obligation: don't have to = not necessary.

traps.question: Which form completes: 'He ______ renew his passport today'?
traps.explanation: Third person singular 'He' takes 'has to': 'He has to renew his passport today.'
traps.ruleHint: Subject Agreement: He/She/It + has to + V1.
